passages.text: At our town museum, a volunteer shows us a model of an old ship engine. Beside it is a sealed bottle of oil, the dark liquid from underground used as fuel. A clear cover helps protect the model from dust and visitors' hands. We look closely without moving the cover or opening the bottle. Ben draws the engine, and Mia copies the information from its label. They put their work together to make a page for our class display. The small exhibit gives us a way to learn from old objects while keeping them in good condition.

parallelText.en: At our town museum, a volunteer shows us a model of an old ship engine.
parallelText.zh: 在镇博物馆，一位志愿者给我们看旧船发动机的模型。

parallelText.en: Beside it is a sealed bottle of oil, the dark liquid from underground used as fuel.
parallelText.zh: 旁边有一瓶密封的石油，也就是来自地下、用作燃料的深色液体。

parallelText.en: A clear cover helps protect the model from dust and visitors' hands.
parallelText.zh: 透明罩帮助保护模型，防止灰尘和访客的手触碰。

parallelText.en: We look closely without moving the cover or opening the bottle.
parallelText.zh: 我们仔细观看，但不移动罩子，也不打开瓶子。

parallelText.en: Ben draws the engine, and Mia copies the information from its label.
parallelText.zh: 本画发动机，米娅抄下标签信息。

parallelText.en: They put their work together to make a page for our class display.
parallelText.zh: 两人把作品合在一起，制作班级展示页。

parallelText.en: The small exhibit gives us a way to learn from old objects while keeping them in good condition.
parallelText.zh: 这个小展品让我们在保持旧物良好状态的同时向它们学习。

closed so that things cannot get in or out

passages.text: Our class visits a small farm to learn how its greenhouse works. A tank holds groundwater that the farmer pumps from a well below the field. The farmer uses this water for the young plants growing inside. On cold mornings, dry wood can burn in a closed stove to give the room heat. We watch from the doorway while the farmer explains the water tank and stove. One group draws the water supply, and another draws the heating equipment. Back at school, we combine the drawings to explain what we learned during the visit.

parallelText.en: Our class visits a small farm to learn how its greenhouse works.
parallelText.zh: 我们班参观一个小农场，了解温室如何运作。

parallelText.en: A tank holds groundwater that the farmer pumps from a well below the field.
parallelText.zh: 水箱里装着农民从田地下方的井里抽出的地下水。

parallelText.en: The farmer uses this water for the young plants growing inside.
parallelText.zh: 农民用这些水浇温室里的幼苗。

parallelText.en: On cold mornings, dry wood can burn in a closed stove to give the room heat.
parallelText.zh: 寒冷的早晨，干木头可以在封闭炉内燃烧，给室内供暖。

parallelText.en: We watch from the doorway while the farmer explains the water tank and stove.
parallelText.zh: 农民讲解水箱和炉子时，我们在门口观察。

parallelText.en: One group draws the water supply, and another draws the heating equipment.
parallelText.zh: 一组画供水装置，另一组画供暖设备。

parallelText.en: Back at school, we combine the drawings to explain what we learned during the visit.
parallelText.zh: 回到学校，我们把画结合起来，说明参观中学到的内容。
